capabilities: Extract text from PDF, Office, HTML, and image files, with vision OCR fallback
Generate reviewed LLM change plans that build and update wiki pages
Chat with the wiki using index-first retrieval and optional embeddings
Lint the wiki for stale claims, contradictions, and missing pages
Auto-commit wiki changes to a local or SSH git remote
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a vault-wide AI assistant; it maintains a wiki derived from one configured raw-source folder.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a detailed privacy section: vault content is sent to the configured endpoint, keys are stored locally, and there is no telemetry. Auto-ingest is disabled by default and undo history covers only the last 20 change sets.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to synthesize scattered raw documents into a maintained wiki or to query it with an LLM before changes are written.
